svg.aria-label: An isometric engineer's desk. A monitor on a post and arm shows an editor with one terracotta line lit; a low-profile keyboard and mouse sit on the desk beside a mug and a small potted plant; a three-drawer cabinet and a cable trough carry the clutter. A person in a hooded top wears over-ear headphones and works at the keyboard, seen from behind on a five-star office chair.
